title: Sammaciccia's guess about SS eugenics programs continued after the war

tellings.quote: point it occurred to me that the SS were involved in eugenics programs and there were rumors that after the war these uh eugenics programs were continued in secret in underground facilities

plain: The SS, the Nazi elite force, ran eugenics programs, attempts to breed "better" humans, and rumor has it these went on in secret in underground sites after the war. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this was the guess of Bruno Sammaciccia, an Italian man who said he had contact with strange beings in the 1950s. Jorjani says the idea "occurred" to Sammaciccia as a way to explain what he had met.
